successors.name: Chu
successors.text: Huang, capital at Huangchuan, Henan ('Capital: Huangchuan'; artifacts unearthed there since 1975)

ledger.x: 704: Huang first appears in the record, refusing Chu's summons.
648: the state of Huang ends in Chu's invasion; the page's last dated event.

wars.name: Chu attack on Huang at Jiling
wars.outcome: In 675 BC 'the King of Chu attacked Huang at Jiling (踖陵) and defeated them'; Huang survived, and by 658 had made a covenant with Qi and Song.

wars.name: Chu conquest of Huang
wars.outcome: Huang refused tribute and was invaded and extinguished by Chu in 648 BC.

certainty.note: No Huang boundary is on the page; soft throughout.
